# Principles of Legal Research

> A comprehensive wiki-based resource for legal research education at the University of Ottawa, offering bilingual course materials and research methodology training for Canadian and Quebec law.

This site hosts course materials for multiple legal research courses taught at the University of Ottawa, including introductory and advanced programs in both English and French. The resource covers case law, legislation, legal citation, and research methodologies across Canadian jurisdictions, maintained by instructors including Margo Jeske and Julie Lavigne.

## Key Topics

- Legal Research Methodology
- Case Law Research
- Legislative Research
- Legal Citation
- Canadian Law
- Quebec Law
- French-Language Legal Research
- Bilingual Legal Terminology
- Bijuralism
- University of Ottawa
- Course Materials
- Canadian Abridgment
- Guide McGill
- Law Education
- Wiki Resources

## Course Materials & Syllabi

- [CML 1101: Principles of Legal Research](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/CML-1101%3A--Principles-of-Legal-Research): CML 1101 course syllabus and legal research methods by Margo Jeske
- [CML 3319: Advanced Legal Research Methodology](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/CML-3319%3A--Advanced-Legal-Research-Methodology): Course materials for CML 3319 Advanced Legal Research Methodology
- [CML 3319: Advanced Legal Research Methodology (Extended)](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/w/page/35752412/CML-3319%3A--Advanced-Legal-Research-Methodology): Advanced legal research training with Margo Jeske covering federal legislation
- [Documents - 2008-09](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/Documents+-+2008-09): Fall 2008 course documents and presentations on case law research

## French-Language Legal Research

- [CML1502 Recherche juridique](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/CML1502+Recherche+juridique): French-language legal research course materials on Canadian law
- [CML1715: Fondements de droit et recherche juridique](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/CML1715%253A-Fondements-de-droit-et-recherche-juridique): French legal foundations and research techniques for Quebec-Ontario law
- [CML 4514 JA: Problèmes pratiques en droit: recherche juridique avancée](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/CML-4514-JA-%3A-Probl%C3%A8mes-pratiques-en-droit-%3A-recherche-juridique-avanc%C3%A9e): Advanced French legal research course covering Canadian and Quebec law
- [TRA 5514 B: Terminologie trans-systémique et documentation: bijuridisme et bilinguisme](http://legalresearchprinciples.pbworks.com/TRA+5514+B+%3A+Terminologie+trans-syst%C3%A9mique+et+documentation+%3A+bijuridisme+et+bilinguisme): Bilingual legal terminology and bijuralism research course materials
